_comment: Every coefficient the engine uses. If a number affects behaviour it lives here, never in C#. Values below are M0 placeholders — M2 tunes them against real simulation runs.

voter._comment: Issue weights are per-bloc and derived from composition; these are the base priors before lived metrics adjust them.

turnout._comment: Turnout scales with happiness and education and can flip close races (§3 Campaigns).

polls._comment: Published polls under-sample low-education, low-turnout districts. Error direction is asserted in the simulation harness, not the magnitude.

lifecycle._comment: EU parties die below the threshold across two consecutive elections; a dead brand may revive if its core grievance resurges.
